name: Dragon's Lair Part II: Escape from Singe's Castle
summary: "Dragon's Lair Part II: Escape from Singe's Castle" continues Dirk's adventure right after rescuing Princess Daphne. Instead of fleeing, he returns to the deadly castle to claim part of its treasure – guarded by the cunning and lethal Lizard King. Only lightning-fast reflexes and perfect timing will help you survive his attacks and avoid giant rolling marbles. You'll race down rapids in a barrel, fly through corridors on a magical horse, and face other dangerous trials. In the end, you must escape the realm of the mud monsters, who rise from the earth to enslave Dirk and turn him into one of them. Navigate the treacherous terrain and leap across the final chasm to win your freedom.
